display_long_description:
Shoot. Skate. Toot. 

Come hang out at the Skate Park, where you can slide down half pipes and pull off sweet tricks while hanging out with your friends - and grab a gun to mow them down. 

In Ape Skate Shootout you can : 
- Complete skateboard tricks and stunts to earn SkateCash, used to upgrade your character or the Skate Park itself
- Charge your farts observing your gas meter, and use them to boost around the Skate Park (or to disrespect your fallen foes). 
- Find a variety of weapons to mow down other players and compete in tense deathmatches
- Combine wacky gadgets and upgrade combos to become the sickest Ape on the half-pipe. 
- Private and public lobby codes to join friends easier

Featuring a unique locomotion system that's easy to learn and difficult to master, and simple gunplay mechanics with a varied upgrade system, every match of Ape Skate Shootout will feel completely different.
